title: Preserve the remaining infinite-dimensional rank-three problem
statement: Covariance rank<=2 and rank3 with rank-one annihilator admit the stated compatibility reductions. Remaining rank3 fields have exact form T Hess psi,with invertible T reduced by actual output symmetry/scale to two continuous shape parameters and orientation. psi remains unrestricted. The finite48Fourier-coefficient diagnostic has36stages,8iteration limits,9shape-boundary hits,no negative proposal. Implemented normalized_gap=Delta/<J_r(G)>;best .06247607730358561 has Delta .012623111817036015 and meanJ .2020471253. Minimum retained rawDelta .006518329238903359 is another row. These are not universal bounds. Later corrected source version and original mistaken proof label remain separate.
